- debrid/high-way-free $.identity_cost.kind: This is the label of the login field, and it accepts a username as well as an email address; it does not show that registration is keyed to an email. The registration form itself was not reached, and the page only says VPN/trashmail sign-ups may be manually reviewed.
- debrid/hizliyukle-com $.reliability_note: The shutdown announcement is supported, but no span carries the date 2026-11-26 (the page is undated; the date is the capture's fetched time), and 'no upload path was available' is not stated by any span.
